simulations.normal: assign arriving trucks to eligible dock windows using appointment, cargo, equipment and labor constraints
simulations.exception: late arrival, unavailable dock, mismatched cargo documents or priority shipment requires reassignment
simulations.degraded: peak queue with reduced dock or labor capacity
simulations.candidate: contextual policy for selecting one eligible recovery action
simulations.baseline: appointment rules, priority queues, constraint programming and supervisor override

simulations.degraded: campaign peak with limited vehicles and support capacity
simulations.candidate: contextual bandit for bounded recovery-action selection
simulations.baseline: configured retry ladders, SLA rules, customer choice and route optimization

simulations.actor: dispatcher coordinating urban pickups and deliveries
simulations.normal: assign new jobs to eligible drivers while preserving route and service constraints
simulations.exception: vehicle failure, cancellation, traffic disruption or missed connection

training_data.observation_unit: one decision point with the state, eligible actions, selected action and later operational outcome
training_data.input_data: appointment, shipment, route, vehicle, driver, dock, labor, customer, traffic and event state available at decision time
training_data.target_or_reward: bounded service, delay, cost and recovery outcome subject to safety, labor, customer and contractual constraints
training_data.label_source: operational execution and final outcome logs; reliable action propensity is currently unknown
training_data.prediction_time: immediately before a recovery, dispatch or reassignment decision
training_data.expected_volume: unknown; must be measured per operation and decision type
training_data.class_balance: not applicable as a fixed class balance; action and outcome frequencies are unknown
training_data.historical_coverage: unknown and likely policy-biased because only chosen actions and their outcomes are recorded
training_data.train_validation_split: time-based and site or route holdout if instrumentation becomes available
training_data.leakage_risks: using final route, revised ETA, completed delivery, later exception codes or supervisor corrections unavailable at decision time
training_data.representativeness_risks: season, region, fleet, customer mix, facility layout, labor rules and disruption regimes
training_data.feedback_loop: recommended actions alter future state and observed outcomes; overrides and reasons must be logged
training_data.privacy_and_usage_constraints: minimize customer and driver data, restrict worker-performance use and preserve human authority
training_data.fallback_if_data_is_insufficient: use deterministic rules, customer choice, rolling-horizon optimization and shadow-mode instrumentation

material_differentiation: No separate opportunity remained after comparison: yard and route decisions are substantially covered by deterministic scheduling, mathematical optimization and current logistics platforms, while bandit or RL evaluation lacks logged propensities, alternative-action outcomes and a safe exploration path.

where_ai_enters.primary_mechanism: bounded policy recommendation among already eligible recovery or dispatch actions
where_ai_enters.human_control: dispatchers and supervisors retain eligibility, override, safety, labor, customer and operational authority
